summary: Travix International is operator of travel services websites, founded in 2011. About 500 employees (Wikidata). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 3 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06

insights.one_liner: Amsterdam online travel company behind CheapTickets, Vliegwinkel and BudgetAir, part of Trip.com Group; marketing and data roles in English.

culture.text: Runs travel booking brands CheapTickets, Vliegwinkel and BudgetAir from Amsterdam.
Roughly 500 employees, though no year is given for that figure.

open.text: IND recognised visa sponsor (Travix International B.V. and Travix Nederland B.V.).
Operates in more than 40 countries as part of Trip.com Group.

worth_knowing.text: Part of Trip.com Group, so big decisions are made by a larger parent company.
